5. Seniority.—() The relative seniority of members of the cadre shall be fixed by the Authority and unless 
decided otherwise on account of special reasons, be governed by their relative seniority existing on the date of 
commencement of these rules. 


(2) All members of the cadre included in the initial formation of the cadre in any grade shall rank senior to all 
members appointed to that grade subsequently. 


(3) The inter-se seniority of persons appointed to the same grade on direct recruitment basis shall be determined 
by the order of merit assigned by the Selection Committee, and the persons appointed as a result of an earlier 
selection shall rank senior to those appointed as a result of a subsequent selection. 


(4) The inter-se seniority of persons appointed to the same grade on promotion basis shall be determined by their 
relative seniority in the lower grade from which they are promoted. 


(5) In the case of a person who is initially appointed on deputation and absorbed later, his seniority in the grade in 
which he or she is absorbed shall normally be counted from the date of absorption, if he or she has, however, been 
holding already (on the date of absorption) the same or equivalent grade on regular basis in his or her parent department, 
such regular service in the grade shall also be taken into account in fixing his/her seniority, subject to the condition that 
he or she shall be given seniority from — 

- the date he or she has been holding the post on deputation, (or) 

- the date from which he or she has been appointed on regular basis to the same or equivalent grade in his parent 

department, whichever is earlier. 


(6) A list of all the officials, in the order of their seniority, and other particulars, shall be prepared and published 
on an annual basis, and a copy of such list shall be provided to all officials of the Authority. 


6. Liability to serve in India.—An official appointed to the cadre shall be liable to serve anywhere in India. 
7. Discharge of duties of higher grade and lower grade in certain cases—The appointing authority may, by 
order, having regard to the exigency of service, direct an official, holding a post in a specific grade to discharge, for 


such period as may be specified in the order, the work and responsibilities of — 


(a) the next higher grade, without any pecuniary benefit; or 
(b) the immediate lower grade, without any pecuniary or other loss.

CONDITIONS OF SERVICE 
8. Medical facilities. — The officials of the Authority, both serving and retired, shall be entitled to medical 
facilities as specified in Schedule-II: 
Provided that the retired officials of the Authority who have rendered not less than three years’ whole-time 
employment in the Authority and a total of twenty years of service in the Authority or the Central Government 
or the State Government or the Union territories Administration or autonomous body or statutory organisation 
or public sector undertakings, shall be entitled to medical facilities. 


9. Contributory Provident Fund. - () The officials of the Authority other than those on deputation, who were 
appointed prior to the date of introduction of the National Pension System in the Authority, shall have the option either 
to continue with the Contributory Provident Fund or subscribe to the National Pension System: 
Provided that the officials appointed on or after the date of introduction of the National Pension System shall 
subscribe to the National Pension System. 


(2) The officials of the Authority appointed on deputation, shall continue to be governed by the Provident Fund 
Scheme as are applicable to them in their parent organisation: 


Provided that the Authority shall recover contribution towards Provident Fund from such officials and remit 
the amount alongwith employer’s contribution to the lending organisation and any loss of interest on account of late 
remittance shall be borne by the Authority. 


20. Travelling allowance. — The officials of the Authority while on tours, including outside India, shall be entitled 
to allowances as are applicable to the officers of the Central Government drawing the pay and allowances in 
corresponding level, from time to time. 


2i. Gratuity. — The officials of the Authority, other than those on deputation, shall be eligible for gratuity in 
accordance with the provisions of the Payment of Gratuity Act, !972 (39 of 972). 

22. Group insurance. — The officials of the Authority, other than those on deputation, shall be entitled to group 
insurance scheme formulated by the Authority. 

23. Pension and other retirement benefits. — The officials of the Authority, other than those on deputation, shall 


not be eligible for pension: 


Provided that the officials of the Authority, excluding the Chairperson, Members and those appointed on 
deputation, appointed on or after the I*t January, 2004 shall be governed by the National Pension System or 
the Unified Pension Scheme regulated under the provisions of the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development 
Authority Act, 20I3 (23 of 203). 


24. Leave. — The Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 972, as amended from time to time shall mutatis mutandis 
apply to the officials of the Authority. 
25. Disciplinary proceedings and impositions of penalties. — In the matter of conduct, discipline and imposition 


of penalties, the Central Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, !964 and the Central Civil Services (Classification, 
Control and Appeal) Rules, [965 and the instructions issued by the Central Government from time to time, 
shall mutatis mutandis apply to the officials of the Authority. 

26. Other conditions of service. — Other conditions of service of the officials of the Authority for which no 
specific provision has been provided, shall be governed by such rules as are from time to time applicable to the 
officers of the Central Government drawing the pay and allowances in corresponding levels.

SCHEDULE-II 
(See rule 8) 
MEDICAL FACILITIES 
(A) OUT-PATIENT TREATMENT 
(!) The Authority shall prepare and maintain a panel of authorised medical practitioners area wise with 
registration number of the concerned registered medical practitioner. 


(2) The out-patient treatment shall be taken from the authorised or notified medical practitioner from the panel 
maintained by the Authority. 


(3) Ifan employee is receiving treatment from the outpatient department of an empanelled hospital or Central 
Government Health Scheme recognised hospital, the attending physician may be treated as deemed 
authorised or notified medical practitioner for the Authority. 


Explanation.-. For the purposes of this paragraph ‘authorised or notified medical practitioner’ means a registered 
medical practitioner having a degree recognised under the National Medical Commission Act, 209 (30 of 20I9) or a 
registered medical practitioner holding degree or diploma in Ayurveda or Unani or Siddha or Homoeopathy of not less 
than four years duration from a recognised university or statutory Board or Council or faculty of Indian Medicine and 
Homoeopathy and equivalent, specified in the Schedules of the National Commission for Indian System of Medicine 
Act, 2020 (4 of 2020) and the National Commission for Homeopathy Act, 2020 (5 of 2020), as the case may be. 


(4) The officials of the Authority and their family members including dependents shall be entitled for the 
reimbursement of medical expenses on actual basis for non-hospitalisation cases, on production of 
prescription from the authorised or notified medical practitioner along with the original bills or cash memos 
of medicines and tests. 


Explanation. — For the purposes of this paragraph, ‘family’ has the same meaning as assigned to it in the Central 
Services (Medical Attendance) Rules, 944. 


(5) Reimbursement in case of treatment during foreign visit shall be in accordance with the Central Services 
(Medical Attendance) Rules, !944, as amended from time to time. 


(B) IN-PATIENT TREATMENT 
(!) The Authority shall prepare and maintain a panel of hospitals or health care organisations or diagnostic 
centres by executing Memorandum of Understanding with each of these organisations already included in 
the panel of the Central Government Health Scheme and are willing to provide in-patient or out-patient 


treatment to the officials of the Authority as per the rates specified by the Ministry of Health and Family 
Welfare, from time to time. 


(2) The officials of the Authority and their family members including dependents shall get medical treatment 
in any of the empanelled hospital or diagnostic centre on the advice of authorised or notified medical 
practitioner. 


(3) The rates admissible for treatment and tests or investigations including hospital accommodation, package 
rates for specified medical or surgical procedures, nursing home facility, etc. shall be as per the rates 
specified by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, from time to time. 


(4) The officials of the Authority shall be entitled for in-patient treatment at the empanelled hospitals. 


(5) Incase of retired employees, their entitlements shall be determined in accordance with their pay drawn at 
the time of retirement. 


(6) In the case of an emergency, the officials of the Authority may directly go to any private or recognised 
private hospital or diagnostic centre and the charges paid for medical expenses, shall be reimbursed, as per 
the rates specified by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare: Provided that where rates are not specified, 
the expenses incurred shall be reimbursed on actual basis. 


(7) The empanelled hospitals or diagnostic centres, shall charge the rates approved for the package rate. 


(8) The credit facility shall be given in emergency cases to the officials of the Authority undertaking treatment 
in these hospitals or diagnostic centres and the bill shall be reimbursed as per approved rates by the 
Authority: 


Provided that in case empanelled hospitals or diagnostic centres insist for immediate payment of cost for 
treatment, hospital accommodation, medicines, various tests, the Authority may sanction advance payment 
of ninety per cent. of the approximate expenses as per package rates specified by the Government and release 
the amount to the empanelled hospital or diagnostic centre through cheque or digital mode.

की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l9th December, 2025 


5.0. 593(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 50700) Dated:28/0/2025, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation of NH248A in 
the stretch of land from Km. 46.95 to Km. 95.958 in the district of Nuh in the state of HARYANA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Indian Express” dated 
03/05/2025 , “amar ujala” dated 04/05/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

S.0.5932(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and

the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH37 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 3]5.3]5 to Km. 403 in the district of KARBI ANGLONG in the state of ASSAM.

, ‘Purvanchal Prahari” dated 30/[0/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th December, 2025 


S.0.5933(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 4601 Dated:08/10/2025 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(1i) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH37 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 315.315 to Km. 403 in the district of GOLAGHAT in the state of ASSAM 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India” dated 
30/10/2025 , “Purvanchal Prahari” dated 30/10/2025 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 5906(अ).-- केन्द्रीय सरकार, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके पश्चात्‌ 
उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह समाधान हो जाने 
के पश्चात्‌ कि गुजरात राज्य के महेसाणा जिले में NH-168G के कि.मी. 34.30 से कि.मी. 62.60 तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण 
(चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए 
वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया गया है, ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की 
घोषणा करती है। 

कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा | 

ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌ अनुमंडल पदाधिकारी एवं प्रान्त अधिकारी को लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत 
की जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी, आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या 
किसी विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात्‌ तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने 
के पश्चात्‌, यदि कोई हो, जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 19th December, 2025 


S.O. 5906 (E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways Act, 
1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH-168G in the 
stretch of land from Km. 34.30 to Km. 62.60 in the district of MAHESANA in the state of GUJARAT, hereby declares 
its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Magistrate and Prant 
Officer in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow 
the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

का.आ. 5930(अ).--रेलवे अधिनियम, 1989 (1989 का 24) की धारा 20/ की उप-धारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों 
का प्रयोग करते हुए (जिसे आगे “उक्त अधिनियम” कहा गया है), केंद्र सरकार, इस तथ्य से संतुष्ट होने के पश्चात्‌ कि सार्वजनिक 
उद्देश्य की पूर्ति हेतु अनुसूची में संलग्न भूमि का संक्षिप्त विवरण, कर्नाटक राज्य के रायचूर जिले के रायचूर तालुका के खानापुर 
एवं मार्चेटहल गाँवों में किमी 552/8-9 पर स्थित समपार संख्या 215 के स्थान पर सड़क उपरि सेतु के निर्माण, अर्थात्‌ एक 
विशेष रेलवे परियोजना के निष्पादन के लिए आवश्यक है, एतद्‌ द्वारा ऐसी भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने की अपनी मंशा घोषित 
करती है। 


कोई भी व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में रुचि रखता है, वह इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन की तारीख से तीस (30)

का.आ. 5940(अ).--- भारत सरकार ने पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइन (भूमि मे उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन) 
अधिनियम, 4962 (4962 का 50) जिसे इसमे इसके पश्चात उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3 कि उपधारा () के 
अधीन जारी भारत सरकार के पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का. आ. 3577(अ) तारीख 
34.07.2025 जो भारत के असाधारण राजपत्र तारीख 04.08.2025 मे प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उस अधिसूचना से संलग्न 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि में मैसर्स इंद्रधनुष गैस ग्रिड लिमिटेड द्वारा असम राज्य में सिलचर - पानीसागर प्रकृतिक गैस 
पाइपलाइन के मधायम से प्रकृतिक गैस के परिवहन के लिए पाइपलाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए उपयोग के अधिकार का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त राजपत्रित अधिसूचना की प्रतियाँ जनता को उपलब्ध करा दी गई थी; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने जनता से प्राप्त आक्षेपों को परीक्षण के उपरांत निपटान कर दिया है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उप - धारा () के अधीन भारत सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट 
दे दी है; 

और भारत सरकार ने, उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पश्चात और यह संतुष्ट हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि पाइपलाइन 
बिछाने के लिए अपेक्षित है, उसमें उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने का विनिश्चय किया है; 


8560 GI/2025 (4)

[PART II—SEc. 3(ii)] 


अतः अब, भारत सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 कि उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुये,

New Delhi, the 9th December, 2025 


9.0. 590(E).— Whereas by notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural 
Gas S.O.No.3577(E) dated the 3!.07.2025, issued under sub-section (l) of section 3 of the Petroleum and Minerals 
Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 962 (50 of 962), (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), 
published in the Extra Ordinary Gazette of India dated the 04.08.2025, the Government of India declared its intention 
to acquire the Right of User in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification for the purpose of laying 
pipeline for transportation of Natural Gas through Silchar - Panisagar Section of North East Natural Gas Pipeline in the 
state of Assam by Indradhanush Gas Grid Limited (IGGL). 


And whereas copies of the said Extraordinary Gazette notification were made available to the public. 


And whereas the objections received from the public to the laying of the pipeline have been considered and 
disposed by the Competent Authority. 


And whereas the Competent Authority has, under sub-section (l) of section 6 of the said Act submitted its 
report to the Government of India. 


And whereas the Government of India after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said land 
is required for laying the pipeline, has decided to acquire right of user therein; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of the section 6 of the said Act, the 
Government of India hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline;

of India hereby directs that the Right of User in the land for laying the pipeline shall, instead of vesting in Government

in the district of Sambalpur in the state of Odisha, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may within a period of thirty days from the date of publication of the 
notification in the Official Gazette, raise objection to the acquisition of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub- 
section () of section 20D of the said Act. 


Every objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely Spl. Land Acquisition Officer, Collectorate, 
Sambalpur, State—Odisha for Construction of 3 & 47 Line from Jarapada to Sambalpur City (254.4 Km), in writing, 
and shall set out grounds thereof and competent authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either 
in person or through a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further inquiry, 
if any, as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of 20D of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

“Times of India(English)” both dated 16.07.2025; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately;

submitted its report to the Central Government;

conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land

And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;
